ai.title: Fix resolveMessageId call on AI SDK error
ai.summary: promptAiSdkStream now calls options.resolveMessageId(undefined) when the AI SDK throws an error, preventing hanging message ID promises. The resolveMessageId signature changed from optional to required in ai-sdk.ts, and the underlying Promise.withResolvers generic updated to string | undefined in prompt-agent-stream.ts. This ensures agent streams terminate cleanly even during upstream API failures. Backend only; no user-facing config changes.

eli5.text: When the assistant's connection to the AI model fails mid-response, the system previously left behind a dangling request that could stall the backend. It now sends that request a proper 'no message' signal before stopping, so the process ends cleanly even during upstream API failures. The fix is live today and applies to internal backend streaming, with no changes you can configure.
